text: Ideation: Ger. vorstellende Thätigkeit ; Fr. idéation ; Ital. attività rappresentatrice , ideazione . Mental process which takes the form of a succession of ideas. Suggested and explained by J. S. Mill, Logic , ii. 216. The adjective form 'ideational,' as applied to such a process, is more exact than is ideal. ( G.F.S. - J.M.B. )
